title: Revert extra_ai_* unless each EnemyDef slot is bank-log named
description:
ida_types.h EnemyDef renamed field_16/field_24/… to extra_ai_1..7. Several of those words are unused/padding in the vanilla header. extra_ai_* claims a type contract that is not established.

Keep the good bit renames: kEnemyProps_Intangible, ProcessInstructions, SolidToSamus.

For unknown words: unused_18 / unused_26 / unused_28 / unused_2C / … or restore field_* until the bank log name is known. Cite the header layout if renaming.

Also drop MiniEnemyDefLooksUnusable() silent fallback in src/mini/mini_enemy_metadata.c — mini either has a real EnemyDef or an explicit species table. Do not guess from “the ROM struct looks empty.”

Estimate: 20 min
Acceptance: No extra_ai_* names on undocumented EnemyDef words; kEnemyProps_* bit names kept; mini reaction helpers do not paper over a missing EnemyDef.

title: Route CallHitboxShot/CallHitboxTouch through CallEnemyAi
description:
enemy_shot.c::CallHitboxShot and enemy_touch.c::CallHitboxTouch are incomplete ROM-address switches that duplicate CallEnemyAi. If CallEnemyAi must exist for this patch, these two must call it (or a single shared helper). Do not keep a second Unreachable() table.

Do not try to delete CallEnemyAi in this task.

Estimate: 25 min
Acceptance: No second ROM-address hitbox switch; multibox shot/touch still reach the same handlers; Unreachable() cannot fire from a missing duplicate case.

title: Validate A0 peel: build + mini-test + origin map
description:
After the peel fixes:
- python3 -m pytest tests/test_build.py -q
- make mini-test
- If runtime behavior may have shifted: python3 tests/run_tests.py -v (re-run flaky SPC once before investigating).
- Confirm bank_origin_map.md lists enemy_dispatch/shot/touch/block_collision/samus_status and no longer points collision at a husk.
- CORE_SRCS is wildcard src/*.c so new files link; do not leave a .c that is unused.

Compare any surprising change against ../sm/src/sm_a0.c before “fixing” it.

Estimate: 40 min
Acceptance: test_build.py passes; mini-test passes; bank_origin_map.md matches the landed files; no new unused translation units.

title: [vanilla 1] Land A0 collision peel without freezing the SNES ABI
description:
Current uncommitted WIP already extracted enemy_dispatch.c, enemy_shot.c, enemy_touch.c, enemy_block_collision.c, samus_status.c from enemy_main/enemy_collision. samus_status (Torizo freeze → generic lockout) stays.

Do NOT land as-is. Finish the peel so it is a real module boundary, not relocated ASM.

Out of scope: deleting CallEnemyAi, splitting $A8/$A2/$A6 dumps, C-ifying enemy_block_collision LABEL_7 (unless cheap and local).

Estimate: 240 min
Acceptance: WIP is behavior-preserving and reviewable: no enemy_collision.c husk, one hitbox dispatch path, no assert(0) on the Samus-projectile path, projectile magics use kProjectileType_*, extra_ai_* reverted unless bank-log named, samus_status kept, tests pass.

comments.author: Lucas Vinze
comments.text: Dispatched to subagent to complete all five land_a0 children in order: dvp (husk) -> 8qm (hitbox) -> lw5 (shot C-ify) -> 3iu (EnemyDef fields) -> 9i7 (tests). Do not delete CallEnemyAi. Keep samus_status.

title: Fold enemy_collision.c husk into the right homes
description:
src/enemy_collision.c is 30 lines: EnemyCollisionHandler, func_nullsub_4, SuitDamageDivision.

SuitDamageDivision is Samus damage — move next to samus_status/samus_resource.
EnemyCollisionHandler is a 10-line orchestrator — move into enemy_touch.c or keep only if the file still owns collision. Delete the husk file if nothing remains.
Update bank_origin_map.md and any includes.

Estimate: 30 min
Acceptance: No 30-line enemy_collision.c; SuitDamageDivision lives with Samus damage; EnemyCollisionHandler has a real home; full build still links.

title: C-ify enemy_shot.c: assert(0), projectile magics, byte overlays
description:
In src/enemy_shot.c (and the same checks copied in EprojCollHandler*):
- Remove assert(0) on the Samus-hits-own-projectile path. Compare ../sm/src/sm_a0.c and keep vanilla behavior; do not leave a crash in a reachable handler.
- Replace 768/1280/1792/0xF00 with kProjectileType_PowerBomb, Bomb, BeamExplosion, TypeMask (ida_types.h).
- Replace k>>1 and *(uint16*)((uint8*)eproj_id+k) with indexed eproj_* arrays.
- Prefer kProjectileType_* / named dir flags over 0x10/0xFF00 where the meaning is known.

If a path is genuinely unreachable in vanilla, document why with a comment citing the original address — still do not assert(0) in gameplay.

Estimate: 60 min
Acceptance: enemy_shot.c has no assert(0); projectile type checks use kProjectileType_*; no (uint8*) overlay on eproj_id; behavior matches ../sm/ for the A0 projectile-interaction handlers.

title: [epic1 physics] Port & Refactor Standing/Running movement and X/Y utilities into physics.c
description: Move the floor-level physics logic (Standing, Running, and basic coordinate updates) from Bank 90 to the native physics.c module. Goal: Get the first passing horizontal movement test and clean up IDA-style registers.
acceptance_criteria: Standing/Running logic native in physics.c; tests/test_physics.py passes horizontal movement; no duplicate symbols.

title: Fully moddable SM canvas per expanded README
description: Fully moddable SM canvas per expanded README. Reuse existing fully-functional ../super_metroid_editor (Kotlin/Compose desktop ROM hacker with comprehensive tile/pixel/slope/room/entity editing) instead of reinventing ImGui/CLI editors. Focus on bridge/integration (export/import JSON/ROM, live hooks, runtime data loading from editor outputs), physics params, hybrid C port, tests, multiplayer, RL observability. Hybrid C/asm OK. Baby steps with tests. See README Epics 0-6 + editor_app.py, editor_bridge.py.
notes: Updated per feedback: leverage ../super_metroid_editor for all tile/room/enemy editing capabilities. Avoid duplication. Prioritize data interchange and runtime integration with sm_rev engine.

title: [vanilla 2] Canonicalize EnemyDef function pointers (delete the address ABI)
description:
The remaining enemy runtime is still SNES call convention: CallEnemyAi(bank<<16|offset) plus per-bank identity wrappers (Enemy_NormalTouchAI_A2 through _B3, EnemyInstr_Goto_A2 through _B3).

Code judo: when an EnemyDef is loaded, map bank-local copies of the standard handlers onto the canonical C functions. Then one NormalEnemyTouchAi exists, CallHitbox* disappear, and CallEnemyAi can die.

This is the highest-risk behavior change left. Full headless suite required. Do not generate a prettier 1129-line switch.

Estimate: 480 min
Acceptance: Standard touch/shot/frozen/powerbomb/grapple/instr handlers are unique C functions; EnemyDef load rewrites bank-local aliases; CallEnemyAi(uint32) is gone or only used for truly unique creature AI that has not yet been converted to function pointers.

title: Normalize standard AI/instr pointers when EnemyDef is loaded
description:
Add a load-time alias table: A28023/A38023/A88023/… → NormalEnemyTouchAi, and the same for shot/frozen/powerbomb/grapple/nullsub and shared EnemyInstr_Goto/SetTimer/Sleep/WaitNframes.

Apply in get_EnemyDef_A2 / LoadEnemies / GetEnemyDefOverride so ROM defs and JSON overrides both canonicalize.

Keep unique creature AI as bank+offset until those files are C function pointers (later).

Estimate: 180 min
Acceptance: Loading any vanilla EnemyDef that used a bank-local Normal* stub stores the canonical handler; game boot + enemy rooms still run those stubs as the same C function.

title: Delete per-bank Enemy_Normal*AI_* and shared instr identity wrappers
description:
After load-time canonicalization, delete Enemy_NormalTouchAI_A2/A3/A4/A5/A6/A8/B3 (and shot/frozen/powerbomb/grapple copies) from leftover bank files. Same for bank-local EnemyInstr_Goto_* aliases in enemy_dispatch.c.

CallEnemyAi cases for those aliases can collapse to the canonical function or disappear if the switch is already keyed on canonical addresses.

Estimate: 120 min
Acceptance: No Enemy_Normal*AI_A2..B3 identity wrappers remain; dispatch still reaches NormalEnemyTouchAi/ShotAi/etc.; tests pass.

title: Finish vanilla C cleanliness
description:
Bank-shaped sm_*.c files are gone. Remaining work is decompiler-shaped C: ROM-address dispatch, leftover bank dumps with topical names, identity bank wrappers, funcs.h soup, and ASM leftovers (RomFixedPtr, goto, v0).

This is the full-build parity track, not mini/mod. Do not treat enemy_dispatch.c as the destination architecture.

Sequence:
1. Land the in-progress A0 collision peel properly.
2. Canonicalize EnemyDef AI/instruction pointers at load; delete CallEnemyAi(uint32) and bank-local identity wrappers.
3. Split leftover $A2/$A6/$A8/$A9/$86/$A3 dumps by creature.
4. C-ify creature files (named tables, no v0/LABEL_, kSfx/kProjectileType).
5. Carve funcs.h into topical headers.
6. Cinematics last.

Do not: polish enemy_dispatch.c into three switches; rename unknown EnemyDef words to extra_ai_*; C-ify a 4k dump in place; start cinematics/menus/spc_player first.

Acceptance: No leftover bank-dump files named after one creature while holding many; no CallEnemyAi(uint32 ea) ROM switch in the enemy runtime; standard touch/shot/frozen/powerbomb/instr handlers exist once; funcs.h is no longer the only enemy/Samus prototype dump; full `make` parity still holds.

comments.author: Lucas Vinze
comments.text: Created 2026-08-27 from vanilla cleanliness code-review. Sequence: a6e land A0 peel, 1bq canonicalize EnemyDef ABI, m23 split leftover dumps, 0ko C-ify, b19 funcs.h, ebi Samus semantic (parallel), 4l2 cinematics last.

title: Retire CallEnemyAi/PreInstr/Instr ROM-address switches
description:
Replace remaining CallEnemyAi(uint32 ea) with typed function pointers on EnemyDef (or a compact creature vtable). Unique creature main/init/shot/touch stay as C functions; the switch is not regenerated.

enemy_dispatch.c should shrink dramatically or be deleted. Instruction bytecode can become a per-bank opcode table later; this task at least removes the 24-bit address as the public API.

High regression risk: run full runtime tests, not only test_build.

Estimate: 180 min
Acceptance: Gameplay no longer looks up enemy AI by 24-bit ROM address; enemy_dispatch.c is gone or <200 lines of leftover unique cases with a plan to drain them; python3 tests/run_tests.py -v passes.

title: Audit function coverage: grep TODOs, list ported vs stub functions across sm_*.c
description: Run grep for TODO/UNIMPLEMENTED/stub across src/sm_*.c. Produce a coverage table (bank → ported%, stub count). Save to docs/coverage.md. No code changes needed.
acceptance_criteria: docs/coverage.md exists listing each sm_*.c with function count, stub count, % complete

title: Implement 'make test' harness: Python script that builds sm_rev and runs smoke tests
description: Add a Makefile 'test' target that invokes a Python test runner. Test 1: 'make' succeeds (binary exists). Test 2: binary exits cleanly with --help or headless flag. Wire to CI pattern from platformer_common.
acceptance_criteria: 'make test' exits 0 with >=1 passing test; no ROM required for the harness itself

title: Load save state and verify Samus spawns in correct starting room (headless)
description: Use custom_integrations/SuperMetroid-Snes/ states. Add a headless mode or test hook that loads a state, steps 1 frame, reads room_id from RAM, asserts matches expected. Wire into make test.
acceptance_criteria: Test passes: load state → room_id == expected value (Crateria landing site)

title: Physics baseline test: verify Samus velocity after known input sequence
description: Capture known physics values: initial jump velocity, horizontal accel cap, gravity constant from variables.h. Write a unit test that simulates N frames of input and asserts RAM values match. No graphics needed.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts samus_y_velocity after jump input == expected constant from ROM; passes in make test

acceptance_criteria: make test runs screenshot compare; diff == 0 on clean build

2958 LOC, 34 sub_* names. Remaining combat eproj after core/environment/Tourian/Torizo peels: Skree/Draygon/Crocomire/Kraid/Mini-Kraid, pirate/Ceres/Shaktool, Ki-Hunter/Kago/Maridia/WS robot/n00b tube/spore, Botwoon/Yapping Maw, pickup/death-explosion/sparks.

Acceptance: eproj_combat.c is gone or is a small leftover with a listed drain plan; families have named files; origin map updated; tests pass.

description:
These files are still bank files with better names. Split by creature BEFORE C-ifying. One family per patch. Update bank_origin_map.md in the same patch.

Do not C-ify v0/RomFixedPtr inside a 4k file in the same change as the move.

Morph ball segfault on acquisition
description:
Game crashes with segfault when acquiring morph ball item. Memory corruption in OAM at frame @5546. Verification shows 26 failed bytes in VRAM OAM compare, likely sprite/tile data handling issue during item collection animation.

Memory diff shows OAM corruption:
- Bytes 0x000026-0x000035 show sprite coordinate/attribute corruption
- Stacktrace needed

Repro: Get morph ball item in game, observe crash at frame ~5546.

Acceptance: morph ball acquisition works without crash.

title: Integrate super_metroid_editor for live tile editing
description: Bridge sm_rev runtime with ../super_metroid_editor: support loading edited room/tile data (JSON or direct ROM patch), live reload on editor save, or embed editor via bridge. Replace planned ImGui overlay. Leverage existing Kotlin editor's full tile, pixel, slope, Layer3 capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Can click a tile, change it, see visual update in <1 frame; save to JSON persists across restart

acceptance_criteria: Tool lists enemies; edits persist to JSON; sm_rev loads JSON and applies overrides

acceptance_criteria: Dispatch table exists; toggling a function between C and asm produces identical game behavior for a known function

description: Same audit as sm_80.c but for all A-banks (sm_a0 through sm_a9, sm_aa, sm_ad). These are mostly enemy/item logic. Extend docs/coverage.md.

acceptance_criteria: Selected system runs from C impl; game boots to Crateria and the ported system triggers without regression; test passes

acceptance_criteria: Two Samus on screen respond to separate joypad inputs independently; no state bleed between instances

title: Expand PhysicsParams struct to cover all Samus motion variables

acceptance_criteria: PhysicsParams covers gravity, h/v accel caps, jump velocity, walljump, shinespark trigger; defaults produce identical behavior to baseline

title: Live-reload PhysicsParams: file-watch sm_physics.json and apply on change
description: Poll or inotify-watch sm_physics.json. On modification, reload PhysicsParams and call RtlApplyPhysicsParams() without restart. Add hotkey (e.g. F5) as manual trigger.
acceptance_criteria: Edit sm_physics.json while running; Samus physics change within 1 second without restart

title: [vanilla 4] C-ify topical enemy/eproj files (no 4k dumps)

Bar for a creature file: named ROM tables instead of RomFixedPtr macros; no v0/LABEL_/goto leftover; kSfx_* / kEnemyProps_* / kProjectileType_*; structs instead of r18_r20; file stays under ~1k or has a reason.

Never start this on a leftover bank dump. Already-split bosses can start after the A0 peel.

Acceptance: Remaining gameplay enemy/eproj files are topical and C-like by the bar above; no new RomFixedPtr macros in those files.

title: Document the per-file C-ify bar and apply it to already-split bosses

Apply the C-ify bar inside already-split topical bosses (do not wait for $A8 dump split):
enemy_kraid.c (2100), enemy_phantoon.c (1887), enemy_crocomire.c (1646), enemy_botwoon.c (1403), enemy_draygon.c (1361), enemy_torizo.c (1027).

Estimate: 360 min
Acceptance: Each listed boss file has a landed C-ify pass or an explicit leftover list in the bead notes; no file grows past 1k because of the pass.

title: [vanilla 5] Carve funcs.h into topical headers
description:
funcs.h is 7994 lines and still the only prototype dump. New enemy_*.c files include funcs.h + variables.h + ida_types.h + sm_rtl.h.

Start with the A0 peel files: enemy_touch.h, enemy_shot.h, enemy_block_collision.h, samus_status.h (already exists). Stop adding prototypes to funcs.h. Re-export from funcs.h during the transition if needed.

Estimate: 240 min
Acceptance: New enemy/Samus modules declare in their own headers; funcs.h shrinks over time and is not the place new prototypes land.

title: C-ify newly split A8/A2/A6/A9/A3/86 creature files

After dump splits, walk each new creature file and apply the C-ify bar. Prefer one family per patch. This is many small diffs, not one mega-PR.

Estimate: 480 min
Acceptance: New creature files from the dump splits meet the C-ify bar or have a leftover note; no 2k+ mixed file remains.

Do not split these for the line count. This is parallel to the enemy dump work, not a substitute.

title: Named poses, movement states, and materials in remaining Samus hot paths

Continue semantic cleanup in samus_runtime.c, samus_grapple.c, samus_transition.c, samus_xray.c, samus_collision_block.c. Use ida_types.h pose constants and block_reaction.h materials. Replace hex pose/movement checks as they are touched.

Acceptance: Touched hot paths use kPose_* / movement-type names / block material helpers; behavior unchanged.

title: Add headers for enemy_touch/shot/block_collision/dispatch and stop dumping into funcs.h
description:
Give the landed A0 modules real headers. Move CallEnemyAi declarations off sm_rtl.h once canonicalize retires them. Do not put EnemyInstr_* on sm_rtl.h as a growing dump (already started in the WIP).

cinematics.c is 6395 LOC (Bank $8B). Presentation-only. Split into cinematic_ppu/bg/sprite/palette/intro/ending + credits.c only when a cinematics task needs it. Menus and spc_player.c are the same bucket: not the vanilla-gameplay cleanliness path.

title: ImGui debug panel for PhysicsParams: sliders for all fields, live apply
description: Add ImGui window 'Physics' with sliders/spinners for each PhysicsParams field. On slider change call RtlApplyPhysicsParams(). Add 'Save to JSON' and 'Reset to defaults' buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Open physics panel, drag gravity slider, Samus falls faster/slower in real time; save persists

title: RL harness state observation hooks: expose room_id, Samus pos/hp/energy to Python
description: Add C API (sm_rtl.h) for reading: current room_id, samus_x, samus_y, current_health, current_energy, items_collected. Wire into retro_harness env.py observation space. Verify via platformer_common SM level.
acceptance_criteria: Python env.step() returns obs dict with all 6 fields; values match RAM reads; SM level in platformer_common selftest passes

title: ROM-hack export: write modified room/enemy data back to .smc ROM file
description: Add export command that takes current in-memory state (modified rooms, enemy tables) and writes a patched .smc. Use original ROM as base. Must produce a valid ROM that boots in Snes9x.
acceptance_criteria: Export produces .smc; load in Snes9x; modified room renders correctly; all other rooms unchanged

title: Battle arena mode: custom ruleset (HP, timer, win condition) via config JSON
description: Add arena_config.json: starting hp, timer, win condition (last hp standing, score, timer). Load at startup. Wire to existing health RAM variables. Add 'arena' launch flag. Basis for ALTTP-style battle arena.
acceptance_criteria: Two players spawn, arena timer counts down, player with higher HP wins when timer hits 0; all values configurable from JSON
